_comment: Central fleet sizing. Risk = risk_pct × broker_equity. Anchor is strictly dynamic from broker truth — no fallback, no ceiling. If broker is unavailable, runners enter READ_ONLY mode and refuse new entries (see BrokerEquityUnavailableError in helio/fleet_sizing.py). When switching paper→live, the same code path reads real broker equity — no config change needed.
_architecture: 2026-04-23: removed fallback_anchor_usd and max_anchor_usd. Preprod now fully mirrors prod. IBKR paper account must be reset to the intended starting balance in Client Portal; there is no safety net.
_tiers_note: Confidence-based risk_pct. Each strategy's risk scales with measured live performance (last 90 days). Tiers evaluated per trade. Drawdown brake halves the tier if current dd > 50% of peak_pnl.
_strategy_live_cutoffs_note: ISO-8601 timestamp per strategy. Trades with ts before this are excluded from tier stats. If unset, all trades count.
_notional_caps_note: Position notional_usd must be <= anchor × multiplier. Prevents sizing that would fail on a real funded account even if risk math says OK. 2026-04-24: stock+etf tightened 2.0→1.0 per user feedback — $10K account shouldn't hold $23K positions. FX stays at 20.0 (pip-stops make leveraged FX safe); micro_future stays at 5.0 (futures margin is ~10% notional).
